sa21:1.2: One time, the Buddha was staying at Anāthapiṇḍada’s Park in Jeta’s Grove of Śrāvastī.
sa21:2.1: There was then a certain monk who rose from his seat, [adjusted his robes to bare his right shoulder,] bowed to the Buddha, [and withdrew to stand at one side].
sa21:2.2: He then said to the Buddha,
sa21:2.3: “[It would be good,] Bhagavān, if you were to give me a brief explanation of the Dharma.
sa21:2.4: Having listened to the Dharma, I will go alone to a quiet place, focus on contemplation, and live earnestly.
sa21:2.5: Having lived earnestly, I’ll then think,
sa21:2.6: ‘A good son [leaves home, cuts off his hair and beard, puts on the Dharma robes,] believes at home in being homeless, and leaves home … up to …
sa21:2.7: He himself knows that he won’t be subject to a later existence.’”
sa21:3.1: The Bhagavān then told that monk,
sa21:3.3: ‘It would be good, Bhagavān, if you were to give me a brief explanation of the Dharma.
sa21:3.4: Having listened to the Dharma, I’ll go alone to a quiet place, focus on contemplation, and live earnestly … up to …
sa21:3.5: “He himself knows that he won’t be subject to a later existence.”’ [Is this what you said?]”
sa21:4.1: The monk said to the Buddha,
sa21:5.2: “Listen closely! Listen closely, and consider it well.
sa21:5.3: I will explain this for you.
sa21:5.4: Monk, when one is shaken, they are tied up by Māra.
sa21:5.5: If one isn’t shaken, then they are free of Māra.”
sa21:6.1: That monk then said to the Buddha,
sa21:7.1: The Buddha said to the monk,
sa21:7.2: “How do you understand my brief explanation of the Dharma in full?”
sa21:8.1: The monk said to the Buddha,
sa21:8.2: “Bhagavān, when form shakes [a person], then they are tied up by Māra.
sa21:8.3: If someone isn’t shaken by it, then they are free of Māra.
sa21:8.4: Thus, when feeling … conception … volition … awareness shakes them, then they are tied up by Māra.
sa21:8.5: If someone isn’t shaken by it, then they are free of Māra.
sa21:8.6: Therefore, I understand the meaning of the Bhagavān’s brief explanation of the Dharma in full.”
sa21:9.2: “Good! It’s good that you understand the meaning of my brief explanation of the Dharma in full.
sa21:9.4: When form shakes a person, then they are tied up by Māra.
sa21:9.5: If someone isn’t shaken by it, then they are free of Māra.
sa21:9.6: Thus, when feeling … conception … volition … awareness shakes them, then they are tied up by Māra.
sa21:9.7: If someone isn’t shaken by it, then they are free of Māra.”
sa21:10.1: … up to … He himself knew that he wouldn’t be subject to a later existence. …
sa21:10.2: mind was liberated, and he became an arhat.”
